name: Hiiragi Mika
source:
Housewife

Mother of one child
Three months pregnant with second child
Currently Breastfeeding
A weak personality

In order to protect her unborn child, she desperately complies with the criminal's requests, but the criminal takes advantage of her obedience and demands extreme play.
